resolution: The pinned VM loader rejected malformed synthetic fixtures: boolean values in numeric/text literal descriptors and sprite layerOrder 0. ListProgram now emits boolean operator reporters for boolean literal requests and assigns sprite layerOrder >= 1. Compiler now rejects boolean saved numeric/text literals; saved scalar and list initial values may still be booleans. All 192 failed cases are rerun in the final corpus; no cases are skipped. These were loader failures, not observed value mismatches.
inputArchiveFormat: gzip-compressed UTF-8 JSONL; line N contains the original failed project for failure row N (one-based)
